policy.scope: explicit historical collection after simulated waits, not live Agent overhead
policy.reason: Separate batch completion SLO from live runtime overhead. Small manual batch <=100ms; 400 evidence batch <=250ms; 20MB redaction/hash/durable collection <=1s (~20MB/s), CPU<=750ms. Rounded product engineering budgets, not universal thresholds or proof of interactive responsiveness. Legacy formula retained as nonblocking stretch comparison.
